subject: More evidence tied physical activity to lower dementia risk
script: From Agewell Brief: More evidence tied physical activity to lower dementia risk. New research from Victoria University adds to evidence that physical activity helps protect against dementia and Alzheimer's. Study links exercise to better brain health in aging. Physical activity may reduce risk of age-related decline. Findings support exercise as key protective habit. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
